bugs.title: USN with 11 characters is accepted at sign-in
bugs.steps: Enter USN 1KV21CS0011 (11 characters) with the DOB of 1KV21CS001 and request an OTP.
bugs.expected: Rejected: a USN is exactly 10 characters.
bugs.actual_in_practice_build: An OTP is sent; the portal matches the first 10 characters.

bugs.title: OTP stays valid for 15 minutes
bugs.steps: Request an OTP, then use the QA panel clock to move forward 12 minutes and enter it.
bugs.actual_in_practice_build: OTP still accepted up to 15 minutes.

bugs.title: The same OTP can be used twice
bugs.steps: Sign in with an OTP, sign out, go back to #/otp and enter the same code again.

bugs.title: Date of birth is not checked at sign-in
bugs.steps: Enter USN 1KV21CS001 with DOB 1999-01-01.
bugs.actual_in_practice_build: An OTP is sent and the user can sign in.

bugs.title: Signing out does not end the session
bugs.steps: Sign in as a student, click Sign out, then open #/student.
bugs.expected: You are asked to sign in again.
bugs.actual_in_practice_build: The dashboard opens; the session was never cleared.

bugs.title: More than 10 copies can be added
bugs.steps: Add a document with Copies = 11.
bugs.actual_in_practice_build: 11 copies are added to the cart.

bugs.title: Zero copies can be added
bugs.steps: Add a document with Copies = 0.
bugs.actual_in_practice_build: A line with 0 copies is added.

bugs.title: Removing a cart line does not refresh the total
bugs.steps: Add CMC and Migration, then remove Migration. Compare the Total fee with the table.
bugs.expected: The total drops to the CMC fee only.
bugs.actual_in_practice_build: The total still includes the removed item until the page is reloaded.

bugs.title: PDC allowed for a student who has not cleared all exams
bugs.steps: Sign in as 1KV20EC045 (not cleared) and add a Provisional Degree Certificate.
bugs.expected: Blocked: PDC needs all exams cleared.
bugs.actual_in_practice_build: PDC is added and can be paid for.

bugs.title: Pre-2005 USN not sent to manual verification
bugs.steps: Sign in as 1KV04CV001 (2004 admission) and start an application.
bugs.expected: A notice says the record will be verified manually; the application is flagged.
bugs.actual_in_practice_build: No notice, no flag; it is treated like any other student.

bugs.title: Files up to 5.5 MB accepted (limit is 5 MB)
bugs.steps: Upload 5.3MB.pdf from QA panel > Test files.

bugs.title: File type not checked from its contents
bugs.steps: Upload fake.pdf (a text file renamed to .pdf).
bugs.actual_in_practice_build: Accepted because the name ends in .pdf.

bugs.title: Images are not virus-scanned
bugs.steps: Upload eicar.png (anti-virus test file). Compare with eicar.pdf.
bugs.expected: Both are blocked by the virus scan.
bugs.actual_in_practice_build: eicar.pdf is blocked but eicar.png is accepted.

bugs.title: Grade cards not required before payment
bugs.steps: Upload only a Government ID and click Proceed to Pay.
bugs.expected: Blocked: semester grade cards are required.

bugs.title: International courier fee is ₹2,250 (should be ₹2,500)
bugs.steps: Choose International Courier and read the delivery fee.

bugs.title: Delivery fee charged once per document
bugs.steps: Add two different documents, choose Speed Post.

bugs.title: Delivery fee never goes down when you change mode
bugs.steps: Choose Courier, then change back to Self-Pickup.
bugs.actual_in_practice_build: Delivery stays at the courier price.

bugs.title: Fee not locked at checkout
bugs.steps: Proceed to Pay, then as admin raise the CMC fee in Fee master; open the payment page again.
bugs.expected: Amount stays at the checkout price.

bugs.title: Waiver code works on any application, more than once
bugs.steps: Registrar issues a waiver for application A. Enter that code on application B.
bugs.expected: Rejected: the code belongs to another application or was already used.
bugs.actual_in_practice_build: Application B is marked paid for free.

bugs.title: Failed payment treated as paid
bugs.steps: On the gateway choose "Failure (declined by bank)" and Pay.
bugs.expected: Status stays Payment pending; the student can retry.

bugs.title: Gateway confirmation not verified
bugs.steps: Use QA panel > Gateway to send a forged confirmation with a wrong signature and ₹1.
bugs.expected: Ignored: signature and amount do not match.

bugs.title: Refund offered after verification has started
bugs.steps: Open an application in Under verification.
bugs.expected: No refund button; fees are non-refundable after scrutiny starts.
bugs.actual_in_practice_build: A Request refund button is shown and works.

bugs.title: Duplicate-debit refund scheduled for T+7 (should be T+5)
bugs.steps: Pay with "Success, but the bank debited twice"; check the refund due date in Finance.

bugs.title: Receipt always shows UPI
bugs.steps: Pay by Card, then open the receipt.

bugs.title: Double-clicking Pay creates two payments
bugs.steps: Double-click Pay.
bugs.actual_in_practice_build: Two payments are recorded and charged.

bugs.title: Query can be raised without a remark
bugs.steps: As clerk, click Raise query with the remark empty.

bugs.title: More than 2 resubmissions allowed
bugs.steps: Raise a query 3 times on the same application and resubmit each time.
bugs.expected: After 2 resubmissions the option is gone.

bugs.title: Clerk can approve without the eligibility check
bugs.steps: Approve a PDC application for 1KV20EC045 (not cleared).
bugs.expected: Blocked: the Tabulation Register shows exams not cleared.

bugs.title: Query notification sent by SMS only
bugs.steps: Raise a query and check the QA outbox.

bugs.title: Expired DSC accepted for signing
bugs.steps: Choose DSC-C3-2025 (expired) and sign.
bugs.actual_in_practice_build: The document is signed and published.

bugs.title: Public verification page shows DOB and mobile
bugs.steps: Verify any signed certificate without signing in.
bugs.expected: Name, USN, document and date only; personal details hidden.
bugs.actual_in_practice_build: DOB and mobile number are shown to anyone.

bugs.title: Verification matches on the first 8 characters of the hash
bugs.steps: Take a valid hash, keep the first 8 characters and change the rest.
bugs.expected: "Not found": the full hash must match.

bugs.title: 12-character AWB accepted at dispatch
bugs.steps: Enter EE12345678IN (12 characters) and save.
bugs.expected: Rejected: India Post numbers are 13 characters (2 letters, 9 digits, IN).

bugs.title: Public tracking ignores the USN
bugs.steps: Track someone else's application ID with your own USN.
bugs.expected: "No application found" unless the ID and USN belong together.

bugs.title: "Verified" milestone missing from the timeline
bugs.steps: Look at the timeline of any application.

bugs.title: Grievance description limited to 1500 characters
bugs.steps: Type 1800 characters and submit.

bugs.title: Four attachments allowed
bugs.steps: Attach 4 PDFs and submit.

bugs.title: Future incident date accepted
bugs.steps: Set the incident date to next year.
bugs.expected: Rejected: cannot be in the future.

bugs.title: Ticket ID has 4 digits instead of 5
bugs.steps: Lodge a grievance and read its ID.

bugs.title: Anti-ragging complaints routed to the college principal
bugs.steps: Lodge an Anti-Ragging grievance; see which inbox gets it.

bugs.title: Revaluation routed to the principal
bugs.steps: Lodge a Revaluation grievance.

bugs.title: Principal sees other colleges' tickets
bugs.steps: Sign in as principal.mv and open the inbox.

bugs.title: SLA counts calendar days, not working days
bugs.steps: Lodge a grievance on a Friday (use the QA clock); check "Respond by".

bugs.title: Amber warning starts at 24 h left (should be 48 h)
bugs.steps: Advance the clock so 30 hours remain; look at the SLA badge.

bugs.title: No escalation from Tier 2 to Tier 3
bugs.steps: Let a Tier-2 ticket pass its SLA (QA clock).

bugs.title: SLA extension can be taken twice
bugs.steps: As the officer, request an extension twice.

bugs.title: Resolved tickets auto-close after 3 days
bugs.steps: Resolve a ticket and read "auto-closes on".

bugs.title: Reopening does not restart the SLA
bugs.steps: Reopen a resolved ticket; check Respond by.
bugs.actual_in_practice_build: The old (nearly expired) deadline is kept.

bugs.title: Second reopen not escalated to the Ombudsperson
bugs.steps: Reopen the same ticket a second time.

bugs.title: Rating accepts values outside 1–5
bugs.steps: In the rating box type 0 (or 9) and click Satisfied.

bugs.title: Officer can edit or delete remarks
bugs.steps: As officer, look at your earlier message in the conversation.
bugs.expected: No edit/delete: the trail is append-only.
bugs.actual_in_practice_build: Edit and Delete links are shown and work.

bugs.title: Grievance form labels not translated
bugs.steps: Switch to ಕನ್ನಡ on the grievance form.

bugs.title: Switching language wipes typed form data
bugs.steps: Type a description, then switch language.

bugs.title: OTP box has no label; hint text too faint
bugs.steps: Inspect the OTP field with a screen reader or browser dev-tools.
bugs.expected: A visible, linked label; hint contrast ≥ 4.5:1.
bugs.actual_in_practice_build: No label; very light grey hint.

bugs.title: MIS open count leaves out escalated tickets
bugs.steps: Compare MIS "Open" with the number of open tickets across all tiers.

bugs.title: Principal's MIS shows all colleges
bugs.steps: Sign in as principal.kv and open MIS.

bugs.title: "Remember this device" skips staff two-factor sign-in
bugs.steps: Tick Remember this device and sign in.
bugs.actual_in_practice_build: Signed in with the password only.

bugs.title: Staff pages open to students by URL
bugs.steps: Signed in as a student, type #/staff/clerk in the address bar.
bugs.expected: "You do not have access to this page".

bugs.title: Script in a grievance runs in the officer's browser (XSS)
bugs.steps: Lodge a grievance whose description contains ; open it as the officer.
bugs.actual_in_practice_build: The script runs in the officer's session.
